[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="30" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_column_text css=""]

Ten brand activation ideas you can actually build — projection mapping, kinetic sculpture, living topiary, AI-animated characters, and oversized props. Collected by Oddtoe, a Melbourne experiential studio that designs and fabricates activations for agencies and brand teams, across Australia and internationally.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][dfd_delimiter delimiter_style="dfd-delimiter-with-icon" icon_size="30" delimiter_border_style="dotted" icon_fontawesome="fas fa-arrow-circle-down" show_icon="enable_icon" delim_line_color="#8224E31C" icon_color="#EEE6F6" icon_hover_color="#D4C9E0"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="35" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="35" screen_tablet_spacer_size="35" screen_mobile_spacer_size="35"][vc_single_image image="16126" img_size="large" alignment="center" css=""][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="35" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="35" screen_tablet_spacer_size="35" screen_mobile_spacer_size="35"][dfd_heading enable_delimiter="" style="style_02" heading_margin="margin-bottom:20px;" subtitle="Before the ideas, the principle..." title_font_options="tag:h2|font_size:70|line_height:64" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_size:38|line_height:32"]

What makes a brand activation work?

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_column_text css=""]

A brand activation works when it gives people something they could not have scrolled past — an object, a moment, or a character that exists only here and now. The strongest activations are built around one clear physical idea, made well, and photographed a thousand times by strangers.

Oddtoe is an experiential design and generative-AI animation studio based in Melbourne, creating projection, installation, and animated work for events, venues, and galleries.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="80" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="80" screen_tablet_spacer_size="80" screen_mobile_spacer_size="80"][dfd_heading enable_delimiter="" style="style_02" heading_margin="margin-bottom:20px;" subtitle="Agencies, producers, brand teams..." title_font_options="tag:h2|font_size:70|line_height:64" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_size:38|line_height:32"]

Who are these ideas for?

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_column_text css=""]

These concepts suit agencies and event producers looking for a build partner, and brand-side marketers planning launches, festivals, retail moments, or conference activations. Every idea below is something Oddtoe designs and fabricates in Melbourne and delivers Australia-wide, with international commissions welcome.

Use the list as a briefing tool rather than a menu. Each idea scales — the same concept can fill a retail corner or anchor a festival site, and most of them combine well (a projection-mapped reveal with a fabricated photo moment, for instance). If your team already has a concept of its own, Oddtoe also works as a fabrication and production partner behind agencies — see how that works on our experiential marketing page.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="60" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="60" screen_tablet_spacer_size="60" screen_mobile_spacer_size="60"][dfd_button button_text="Start a conversation" buttom_link_src="url:https%3A%2F%2Fwww.oddtoe.com%2Fcontact-oddtoe%2F|||" style="style_6" background="#8a8f6a" hover_background="#4e5041" border="border-style:none;|border-radius:5px;" hover_border="border-style:none;|border-radius:5px;"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class="dfd_col-tablet-12" width="1/3" offset="vc_col-lg-4 vc_col-md-2 vc_col-xs-1"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Ideas built on light and motion

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="15" screen_mobile_spacer_size="19"][vc_column_text css=""]

1. A projection-mapped reveal. Wrap a building façade, a stage set, or the product itself in projection mapping and let the launch happen in light. It turns architecture the audience already knows into the announcement itself, and it photographs like nothing else after dark.

2. An animated environment. Instead of one reveal moment, give a wall, floor, or interior a continuously animated skin — an environment that shifts through the evening and makes the venue the talking point. It suits conferences and venue takeovers where people dwell rather than pass through.

3. A kinetic sculpture centrepiece. A kinetic sculpture earns a second look in a way a static display cannot — movement reads as alive. Long-run retail installs, lobbies, and exhibitions get the most from it, because the piece keeps performing for weeks.

4. An AI-animated brand character. A designed character brought to life with generative AI animation can greet visitors on screens, loop through projection content, and carry the campaign onto social afterwards — one character, everywhere at once.

5. A robotic moment. A prop that moves when nobody expects it to — a robotic build timed to react to the crowd — creates the story people tell when they get home. Small mechanism, outsized memory.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="80" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="80" screen_tablet_spacer_size="60" screen_mobile_spacer_size="76"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/6"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Which format fits your brief?

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_column_text css=""]

Formats compared by what they do best — shortlist two or three before you brief:

Format Best for Strongest setting
Projection mapping Product reveals and night-time launches Façades, stages, large interiors
Kinetic sculpture Long-run installs that reward a second look Retail, lobbies, exhibitions
AI-animated characters One character across screens, loops and social Event screens, projection content
Living topiary Slow-burn brand landmarks Gardens, festivals, campuses
Fabricated props The photo moment Launches, pop-ups, photo walls

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" css=".vc_custom_1691550358421{background-color: #26161f !important;}" el_id="pat-article-2"][vc_column width="1/6"][/vc_column][vc_column width="4/6"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="15" screen_mobile_spacer_size="19"][dfd_heading enable_delimiter="" style="style_02" heading_margin="margin-bottom:20px;" subtitle="Five ideas built on craft and character..." title_font_options="tag:h2|font_size:70|line_height:64" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_size:38|line_height:32"]

Ideas built on craft and character

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="15" screen_mobile_spacer_size="19"][vc_column_text css=""]

6. A living topiary sculpture. A brand shape grown and sculpted as living topiary is the opposite of disposable event build — it gets better with time, and it belongs anywhere a festival, campus, or garden wants a landmark rather than a banner.

7. An oversized prop photo moment. The reliable heart of an activation: a fabricated prop at impossible scale. Done with craft, the prop is the campaign — people queue to be photographed with it and publish the evidence for you. Past a certain size, air is the cheapest way to build one — see inflatable artist.

8. A live mural wall. Commission a mural painted live across the day of the event — the artwork is the entertainment, and the finished wall keeps working for the brand long after pack-down.

9. A sensory garden pop-up. A sensory garden slows people down — scent, texture, and green space in a retail or event setting. It suits wellbeing, food, and lifestyle brands that want dwell time rather than spectacle.

10. A scripted character performance. Give the activation a voice: a comedy-written character — performed live or animated — that plays with the audience instead of presenting at them. Humour is the shortest path from stranger to participant.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="30" screen_mobile_spacer_size="38"][dfd_delimiter delimiter_style="dfd-delimiter-with-icon" icon_size="30" delimiter_border_style="dotted" icon_fontawesome="fas fa-arrow-circle-down" show_icon="enable_icon" delim_line_color="#8224E31C" icon_color="#EEE6F6" icon_hover_color="#D4C9E0"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="30" screen_mobile_spacer_size="38"][/vc_column][vc_column width="1/6"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_enable_overlay="" dfd_row_config="full_width_content_paddings" el_id="pat-section-1"][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][dfd_heading enable_delimiter="" style="style_02" heading_margin="margin-bottom:20px;" subtitle="Make it, run it, or both..." title_font_options="tag:h2|font_size:70|line_height:64" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_size:38|line_height:32"]

Does Oddtoe build it, run it, or both?

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_column_text css=""]

Both. Oddtoe designs and fabricates the activation, and can also project-manage and run it on the day — or hand a finished build to your event team. Agencies often use the studio as a quiet build partner behind their own client work.

That flexibility matters when timelines are tight: one studio carrying an idea from concept sketch to fabrication to bump-out removes the hand-off risk between a creative agency, a fabricator, and an event crew. If you are an agency or producer, the working relationship is described on the experiential marketing page; if you are a brand team, start with the moment you want people to have.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check="row-background-dark" dfd_enable_overlay="" dfd_row_config="full_width_content_paddings" el_id="pat-section-2"][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][dfd_heading enable_delimiter="" style="style_02" heading_margin="margin-bottom:20px;" subtitle="A good brief in five lines..." title_font_options="tag:h2|font_size:70|line_height:64" subtitle_font_options="tag:h3|font_size:38|line_height:32"]

How do you brief an experiential studio?

[/dfd_heading][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][vc_column_text css=""]

Bring the audience, the venue or setting, the moment you want people to have, your date, and the rough scale. You do not need a finished concept — two or three ideas from this page plus a clear objective is a strong brief.

Briefs written around outcomes leave room for the craft that makes an activation memorable, while briefs written as shopping lists tend to buy exactly what every other event already had. Describe the reaction you want — stopped, delighted, photographing, talking — and let the format be chosen to earn it.

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="20" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="20" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width="1/3"][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="40" screen_tablet_spacer_size="40" screen_mobile_spacer_size="40"][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]

Questions & Answers

Brand activations

[/vc_column_text][dfd_spacer screen_wide_resolution="1280" screen_wide_spacer_size="40" screen_normal_resolution="1024" screen_tablet_resolution="800" screen_mobile_resolution="480" screen_normal_spacer_size="30" screen_tablet_spacer_size="20" screen_mobile_spacer_size="20"][dfd_accordion style="style-3" active_section="1" font_size="18" tab_title_google_fonts="yes" tab_title_custom_fonts="font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal" icon_size="14"][vc_tta_section title="Does Oddtoe build activations for agencies as a production partner?" tab_id="1685677784578-172f9372-59216fce-87a69a68-2eae"][vc_column_text css=""]

Yes. Agencies and event producers brief Oddtoe as a design and fabrication partner, and the studio is comfortable staying behind the scenes on client-facing work. You bring the client relationship; Oddtoe brings the build.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Does Oddtoe run the activation on the day?" tab_id="1685677784323-438be9dd-da0e6fce-87a69a68-2eae"][vc_column_text css=""]

It can. Alongside design and fabrication, Oddtoe offers event and project management — or hands a finished, tested build to your own event team. The split is agreed up front so nothing falls between crews.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Where does Oddtoe work?" tab_id="1685677784395-526dd6ff-b9c26fce-87a69a68-2eae"][vc_column_text css=""]

The studio is based in Melbourne and delivers activations across Australia, with international commissions welcome — Oddtoe also maintains ties to Berlin and Los Angeles.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="Can generative AI animation be part of a physical activation?" tab_id="1685677784507-83427dcb-7a756fce-87a69a68-2eae"][vc_column_text css=""]

Yes. Artist-led generative AI animation supplies looping screen content, projection material, and brand characters that carry an activation onto social media afterwards — designed and directed by the studio, not left to a prompt.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title="What if we already have a concept?" tab_id="1786584255290-781b75e9-21a0"][vc_column_text css=""]

Bring it. Oddtoe regularly fabricates and produces other teams’ concepts, and will tell you honestly what will and will not survive contact with a real venue, budget, and crowd.

Ideas people stop for...

Brand Activation Ideas

[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner el_class=”dfd_col-tablet-12″ width=”1/3″ offset=”vc_col-lg-4 vc_col-md-2 vc_col-xs-1″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class=”dfd_col-tablet-12″ width=”1/3″ dfd_column_responsive_enable=”dfd-column-responsive-enable” offset=”vc_col-lg-4 vc_col-md-8 vc_col-xs-10″ css=”.vc_custom_1507277465182{padding-right: 0px !important;padding-left: 0px !important;}” responsive_styles=”padding_left_tablet:20|padding_right_tablet:20″][vc_column_text css=””]

Updated August 2026

[/vc_column_text]

[vc_column_text css=””]

Ten brand activation ideas you can actually build — projection mapping, kinetic sculpture, living topiary, AI-animated characters, and oversized props. Collected by Oddtoe, a Melbourne experiential studio that designs and fabricates activations for agencies and brand teams, across Australia and internationally.

[/vc_column_text]

[vc_single_image image=”16126″ img_size=”large” alignment=”center” css=””]

Before the ideas, the principle...

What makes a brand activation work?

[vc_column_text css=””]

A brand activation works when it gives people something they could not have scrolled past — an object, a moment, or a character that exists only here and now. The strongest activations are built around one clear physical idea, made well, and photographed a thousand times by strangers.

Oddtoe is an experiential design and generative-AI animation studio based in Melbourne, creating projection, installation, and animated work for events, venues, and galleries.

[/vc_column_text]

Agencies, producers, brand teams...

Who are these ideas for?

[vc_column_text css=””]

These concepts suit agencies and event producers looking for a build partner, and brand-side marketers planning launches, festivals, retail moments, or conference activations. Every idea below is something Oddtoe designs and fabricates in Melbourne and delivers Australia-wide, with international commissions welcome.

Use the list as a briefing tool rather than a menu. Each idea scales — the same concept can fill a retail corner or anchor a festival site, and most of them combine well (a projection-mapped reveal with a fabricated photo moment, for instance). If your team already has a concept of its own, Oddtoe also works as a fabrication and production partner behind agencies — see how that works on our experiential marketing page.

[/vc_column_text]

Start a conversationStart a conversation
[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner el_class=”dfd_col-tablet-12″ width=”1/3″ offset=”vc_col-lg-4 vc_col-md-2 vc_col-xs-1″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” css=”.vc_custom_1691550358421{background-color: #26161f !important;}” el_id=”pat-article-1″][vc_column width=”1/6″][/vc_column][vc_column width=”4/6″]

Ideas one to five...

Ideas built on light and motion

[vc_column_text css=””]

1. A projection-mapped reveal. Wrap a building façade, a stage set, or the product itself in projection mapping and let the launch happen in light. It turns architecture the audience already knows into the announcement itself, and it photographs like nothing else after dark.

2. An animated environment. Instead of one reveal moment, give a wall, floor, or interior a continuously animated skin — an environment that shifts through the evening and makes the venue the talking point. It suits conferences and venue takeovers where people dwell rather than pass through.

3. A kinetic sculpture centrepiece. A kinetic sculpture earns a second look in a way a static display cannot — movement reads as alive. Long-run retail installs, lobbies, and exhibitions get the most from it, because the piece keeps performing for weeks.

4. An AI-animated brand character. A designed character brought to life with generative AI animation can greet visitors on screens, loop through projection content, and carry the campaign onto social afterwards — one character, everywhere at once.

5. A robotic moment. A prop that moves when nobody expects it to — a robotic build timed to react to the crowd — creates the story people tell when they get home. Small mechanism, outsized memory.

[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/6″][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_enable_overlay=”” dfd_row_config=”full_width_content_paddings” el_id=”pat-table”][vc_column]
[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]

A quick matching matrix...

Which format fits your brief?

[vc_column_text css=””]

Formats compared by what they do best — shortlist two or three before you brief:

Format Best for Strongest setting
Projection mapping Product reveals and night-time launches Façades, stages, large interiors
Kinetic sculpture Long-run installs that reward a second look Retail, lobbies, exhibitions
AI-animated characters One character across screens, loops and social Event screens, projection content
Living topiary Slow-burn brand landmarks Gardens, festivals, campuses
Fabricated props The photo moment Launches, pop-ups, photo walls

[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” css=”.vc_custom_1691550358421{background-color: #26161f !important;}” el_id=”pat-article-2″][vc_column width=”1/6″][/vc_column][vc_column width=”4/6″]

Five ideas built on craft and character...

Ideas built on craft and character

[vc_column_text css=””]

6. A living topiary sculpture. A brand shape grown and sculpted as living topiary is the opposite of disposable event build — it gets better with time, and it belongs anywhere a festival, campus, or garden wants a landmark rather than a banner.

7. An oversized prop photo moment. The reliable heart of an activation: a fabricated prop at impossible scale. Done with craft, the prop is the campaign — people queue to be photographed with it and publish the evidence for you. Past a certain size, air is the cheapest way to build one — see inflatable artist.

8. A live mural wall. Commission a mural painted live across the day of the event — the artwork is the entertainment, and the finished wall keeps working for the brand long after pack-down.

9. A sensory garden pop-up. A sensory garden slows people down — scent, texture, and green space in a retail or event setting. It suits wellbeing, food, and lifestyle brands that want dwell time rather than spectacle.

10. A scripted character performance. Give the activation a voice: a comedy-written character — performed live or animated — that plays with the audience instead of presenting at them. Humour is the shortest path from stranger to participant.

[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/6″][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_enable_overlay=”” dfd_row_config=”full_width_content_paddings” el_id=”pat-section-1″][vc_column]
[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]

Make it, run it, or both...

Does Oddtoe build it, run it, or both?

[vc_column_text css=””]

Both. Oddtoe designs and fabricates the activation, and can also project-manage and run it on the day — or hand a finished build to your event team. Agencies often use the studio as a quiet build partner behind their own client work.

That flexibility matters when timelines are tight: one studio carrying an idea from concept sketch to fabrication to bump-out removes the hand-off risk between a creative agency, a fabricator, and an event crew. If you are an agency or producer, the working relationship is described on the experiential marketing page; if you are a brand team, start with the moment you want people to have.

[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_enable_overlay=”” dfd_row_config=”full_width_content_paddings” el_id=”pat-section-2″][vc_column]
[vc_row_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″]

A good brief in five lines...

How do you brief an experiential studio?

[vc_column_text css=””]

Bring the audience, the venue or setting, the moment you want people to have, your date, and the rough scale. You do not need a finished concept — two or three ideas from this page plus a clear objective is a strong brief.

Briefs written around outcomes leave room for the craft that makes an activation memorable, while briefs written as shopping lists tend to buy exactly what every other event already had. Describe the reaction you want — stopped, delighted, photographing, talking — and let the format be chosen to earn it.

[/vc_column_text]

[/vc_column_inner][vc_column_inner width=”1/3″][/vc_column_inner][/vc_row_inner][/vc_column][vc_column]
[/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_column_text]
[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row bg_check=”row-background-dark” dfd_enable_overlay=”” el_id=”pat-faq”][vc_column width=”1/4″][/vc_column][vc_column width=”1/2″]
[vc_column_text css=”” item_animation=”transition.fadeIn”]

Questions & Answers

Brand activations

[/vc_column_text]

[dfd_accordion style=”style-3″ active_section=”1″ font_size=”18″ tab_title_google_fonts=”yes” tab_title_custom_fonts=”font_family:Arvo%3Aregular%2Citalic%2C700%2C700italic|font_style:700%20bold%20regular%3A700%3Anormal” icon_size=”14″][vc_tta_section title=”Does Oddtoe build activations for agencies as a production partner?” tab_id=”1685677784578-172f9372-59216fce-87a69a68-2eae”][vc_column_text css=””]

Yes. Agencies and event producers brief Oddtoe as a design and fabrication partner, and the studio is comfortable staying behind the scenes on client-facing work. You bring the client relationship; Oddtoe brings the build.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Does Oddtoe run the activation on the day?” tab_id=”1685677784323-438be9dd-da0e6fce-87a69a68-2eae”][vc_column_text css=””]

It can. Alongside design and fabrication, Oddtoe offers event and project management — or hands a finished, tested build to your own event team. The split is agreed up front so nothing falls between crews.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Where does Oddtoe work?” tab_id=”1685677784395-526dd6ff-b9c26fce-87a69a68-2eae”][vc_column_text css=””]

The studio is based in Melbourne and delivers activations across Australia, with international commissions welcome — Oddtoe also maintains ties to Berlin and Los Angeles.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”Can generative AI animation be part of a physical activation?” tab_id=”1685677784507-83427dcb-7a756fce-87a69a68-2eae”][vc_column_text css=””]

Yes. Artist-led generative AI animation supplies looping screen content, projection material, and brand characters that carry an activation onto social media afterwards — designed and directed by the studio, not left to a prompt.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][vc_tta_section title=”What if we already have a concept?” tab_id=”1786584255290-781b75e9-21a0″][vc_column_text css=””]

Bring it. Oddtoe regularly fabricates and produces other teams’ concepts, and will tell you honestly what will and will not survive contact with a real venue, budget, and crowd.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_tta_section][/dfd_accordion][vc_raw_html][/vc_raw_html]
